# Accio Work

> AI-powered desktop and browser workspace for market research, supplier discovery, content generation, and end-to-end business workflow automation. Powered by Alibaba's real supplier and trade data. Free to start, no card required.

## What it is

Accio Work is an execution-oriented AI agent platform (not a chatbot). A general agent plans your goal and hands work to specialist agents for sourcing, design, copywriting and analysis. It reads local files, controls a real browser, runs scheduled automations and connects to 50+ apps. Available on macOS, Windows and directly in the browser.

## Key sections on the landing page

- How it works: from idea to done in four steps (describe goal, agents work, you approve, ship the result)
- Use cases: dropshipping and D2C, supplier sourcing, content and marketing, market research, workflow automation, custom tools
- Accio Work vs a regular AI chat: executes real tasks, uses real Alibaba trade data, multi-agent teams with memory
- Pricing: Free (no card), Pro (usage-based credits), Enterprise (custom)
- FAQ: supported LLMs, browser automation, scheduling, channels (Telegram, Discord, DingTalk, Feishu, WeChat), skills, platforms, agent teams

## Use cases (what Accio Work does for a specific job, all languages)

- [Use cases hub EN](https://acciowork.pro/for)
- [Dropshipping](https://acciowork.pro/for/dropshipping): trend to first sale, product research, supplier, listing and ads
- [Supplier sourcing](https://acciowork.pro/for/sourcing): verified suppliers and drafted inquiries on real Alibaba data
- [Content and marketing](https://acciowork.pro/for/content): landing pages, product cards, social posts, scheduled
- [Market research](https://acciowork.pro/for/market-research): competitors, demand and pricing in a short brief
- [Workflow automation](https://acciowork.pro/for/automation): repeatable multi step tasks on a schedule across apps
- [Custom tools](https://acciowork.pro/for/custom-tools): small internal tools built from a plain description
